description: Get the link to JoinTheDeal's request form for a product the user wants, and see first whether the same item is already requested or on sale as a group deal (then the user should join that instead). This tool does not submit anything and takes no personal information: the user opens the link and fills in the form themselves. When enough people back the same item with a refundable deposit, JoinTheDeal asks the seller for a group price.

item.description: Product name the user wants (optional). Do not include names, emails or phone numbers.

name: request_group_deal
title: Request a group deal
